subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should maintainers accept `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the likely fix adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept CJS package runtime
options.body: Keep ESM as the default, accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for msteams, and merge the linked PR after its validation blocker and exact-head package-runtime checks are green.

options.title: Keep the knob internal-only
options.body: Allow the linked fix only if maintainers are comfortable that `runtimeFormat` remains release-build metadata rather than a documented plugin-author API.

options.title: Choose another packaging design
options.body: Hold the linked PR if package format selection should be expressed through a different build or manifest mechanism.

recommendation.title: Accept CJS package runtime
recommendation.body: Keep ESM as the default, accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` for msteams, and merge the linked PR after its validation blocker and exact-head package-runtime checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the package-local npm runtime builder that would need to own this contract.
